reporting.title: Cost and reporting
reporting.description: Choose one notification entity. Notification groups are supported.

abort.already_configured: An instance with this name already exists.

import_history.title: Import CSV history
import_history.description: Target instance: {instance_name} ({instance_id}). Choose a CSV from this device. Only this instance changes after confirmation.

confirm_import.title: Confirm history import
confirm_import.description: Target instance: {instance_name} ({instance_id}). File: {filename}. Closed: {closed_count}; open: {open_count}; new: {new_count}; identical: {identical_count}; current conflicts: {current_conflict_count}; safe merge: {merge_status}.

export_history.title: Export CSV history
export_history.description: Target instance: {instance_name} ({instance_id}). Choose the current or previous year.

review_anomalies.title: Review consumption anomalies
review_anomalies.description: Select an unresolved event. Legacy aggregates are identified when original details are unavailable.

confirm_anomaly.title: Review anomaly
confirm_anomaly.description: Month: {month}. Detected: {detected_at}. Source: {source}. Previous/new reading: {previous}/{new} kWh. Interval: {interval} minutes. Excluded increment: {excluded} kWh. Plausible limit: {limit} kWh. Reason: {reason}. Estimated impact: {cost} {currency}. Accepting adds it to consumption; confirming exclusion keeps it out and closes the review.

error.history_import_invalid: The CSV is invalid or unsupported.
error.history_invalid_headers: The CSV columns do not match the documented schema.
error.history_closed_month_conflict: A closed month conflicts with the existing ledger and cannot be overwritten.
error.history_open_month_not_current: An open record must refer to the current month.
error.anomaly_review_failed: The anomaly could not be reviewed. Reload the flow and try again.

abort.invalid_export_year: Only the current and previous year can be exported.
abort.missing_export_selection: The export selection is no longer available.
abort.no_pending_anomalies: There are no consumption anomalies awaiting review.
abort.anomaly_not_found: The selected anomaly is no longer available.

options.accept_increment: Accept increment and include it in consumption

options.keep_native: Keep data collected by Energy Report
options.merge_non_overlapping: Merge CSV history with later Energy Report data

init.title: Review consumption anomaly
init.description:
Energy Report observed the cumulative source `{source}` change from {previous} to {new} kWh at {detected_at}, over {interval} minutes. The increment was {excluded} kWh, while the configured plausibility limit was {limit} kWh. It was excluded as a precaution. Estimated impact: {cost} {currency}.

Choose whether to include the increment as valid consumption or confirm that it must remain excluded.

abort.anomaly_already_resolved: This anomaly has already been reviewed.
abort.instance_unavailable: The Energy Report instance is not currently available. Reload it and try again.

legacy_consumption_anomaly.title: Review previous exclusion of {excluded} kWh for {instance}

init.title: Review previous exclusion
init.description:
This is a legacy aggregate for {month}: {excluded} kWh, with an estimated impact of {cost} {currency}. The earlier version stored only the excluded total, so the original timestamp, readings, interval and plausibility limit are not available. Energy Report has not fabricated those details.

Choose whether to include the aggregate as valid consumption or confirm that it must remain excluded.

abort.anomaly_already_resolved: This anomaly has already been reviewed.
abort.instance_unavailable: The Energy Report instance is not currently available. Reload it and try again.
